properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT secret key for signing tokens. Must be at least 32 characters long for security.

properties.name: app.jwt.access-token-expiration
properties.description: Access token expiration time in milliseconds. Default is 900000 (15 minutes).

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-token-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token expiration time in milliseconds. Default is 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: List of allowed origins for CORS requests. Can be URLs or wildcard patterns.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: List of allowed HTTP methods for CORS requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: List of allowed headers for CORS requests (Authorization, Content-Type, etc.).

properties.name: app.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, authorization headers) in CORS requests.

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.max-failed-attempts
properties.description: Maximum number of failed login attempts before account lockout. Default: 5

properties.name: app.auth.lockout.duration-minutes
properties.description: Account lockout duration in minutes. Default: 15 minutes

properties.name: app.audit.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Comma-separated list of trusted proxy IP addresses for extracting real client IP from X-Forwarded-For headers. Example: "172.17.0.1,10.0.0.1"

properties.name: app.audit.retention-days
properties.description: Audit log retention period in days. Audit logs older than this will be automatically deleted.

properties.name: app.audit.fallback-log-path
properties.description: Path for audit fallback log file. Used when database audit logging fails.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.enabled
properties.description: Global flag to enable/disable all rate limiting. When false, rate limiting is completely bypassed.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.login.enabled
properties.description: Enable/disable rate limiting for login endpoint.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.login.requests
properties.description: Number of login requests allowed per time window.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.login.duration-minutes
properties.description: Time window duration in minutes for login rate limiting.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable/disable rate limiting for registration endpoint.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.registration.requests
properties.description: Number of registration requests allowed per time window.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.registration.duration-minutes
properties.description: Time window duration in minutes for registration rate limiting.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.general-api.enabled
properties.description: Enable/disable rate limiting for general API endpoints.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.general-api.requests
properties.description: Number of general API requests allowed per time window.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.general-api.duration-minutes
properties.description: Time window duration in minutes for general API rate limiting.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.refresh.enabled
properties.description: Enable/disable rate limiting for refresh token endpoint.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.refresh.requests
properties.description: Number of refresh token requests allowed per time window.

properties.name: app.rate-limiting.refresh.duration-minutes
properties.description: Time window duration in minutes for refresh token rate limiting.
